description.en: A fossil water-caltrop fruit bears four spreading horns with barbed tips.
description.zh: 化石菱果具四条开展角及倒钩尖端。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Trapa haominiae, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Trapa haominiae 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Four radial barbed arms dominate the silhouette, unlike Iodes's two short face-horns.
distinctness.zh: 四条放射倒钩臂主导轮廓，区别于Iodes两枚短面角。

modeling_brief.en: Build a compact central body and four angular arms; simplify the barbs while preserving backward direction.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立紧凑中央果体和四条角臂，简化倒刺但保留反向指向。

uncertainty: Fossil fruit only; modern floating leaves are not added as a second asset or assumed attachment.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: A new Trapa from the middle Miocene of Zhangpu
sources.supports: Trapa haominiae four spreading barbed horns on fossil fruits.
